account:
Today I have been following my appointment book: morning office business, the ten o'clock mill inspection, lunch at home, and now the one o'clock council letters appointment. The miller was not at the mill when I sought him, so the grain inspection remains incomplete. The baker had also reported being unable to find him earlier. I do not know why he is absent.

The unusual news is repeated talk from townsfolk about a 'bridge or port change' at the bakery and inn. One account mentioned the baker, freight, and neighbour being present at the bakery. I have not seen any physical change, received a clear explanation, or identified a firsthand source. Questions have so far produced only the same vague wording. I cannot yet tell whether this concerns transport, deliveries, or merely a circulating rumour, much less what it is for or who arranged it.

The secretary reported no new council letters or office requests this morning, and no confirmed town gathering needing bread. The baker was checking for bread orders; my three o'clock tea with the neighbour is private, not a town catering request. I have just asked the secretary whether correspondence has arrived and reported the unfinished inspection, but have not heard a reply. The baker is currently near the market holding an emerald; that alone gives me no reason to infer anything unusual.
